text:
Lina (Finance): Heads up - AZCloud Ltd sent invoice 2024-07-12 but there's a VAT + withholding question.
FinanceBot: New invoice uploaded: AZC-7789 amount 12,600.00 USD (vendor submitted document). :paperclip:
Lina (Finance): Invoice shows 18% VAT applied and also vendor is asking for gross-up to cover Azerbaijan withholding tax. invoice snippet: ```Vendor: AZCloud Ltd\nInvoice: AZC-7789\nAmount (net): 10676.27 USD\nVAT 18%: 1921.73 USD\nTotal: 12600.00 USD\nVAT reg no: N/A (they put "pending")``` 
Raj (Vendor Ops): Vendor claims they're a foreign supplier but providing local services - says they need us to gross-up for 10% withholding under Azerbaijani law. They attached a scan of their letter.
Maya (AP): We normally don't gross-up unless contract says so. Do we have PO/contract clause for gross-up with AZCloud? I can't find any.
Omar (Tax): Quick thoughts - two separate issues: local VAT registration (charging VAT) vs withholding on services. If they are registered locally, VAT should show reg no. If not, reverse-charge might apply but that's for local recipients. Gross-up is unusual unless contractually agreed or local tax treaty requires it.
Lina (Finance): Vendor insists they will face a 10% tax at source and asks Redwood to pay a grossed-up amount so they get their quoted net. They sent a statement: "pay additional 1,179.58 USD to compensate".
Raj (Vendor Ops): They sent a scanned certificate labeled "Tax Authority notice" but it's not in English and looks informal.
Omar (Tax): Can you ask them for: 1) Azerbaijani VAT registration number (in official format), 2) formal withholding certificate from payer (if they already paid), 3) copy of contract clause that requires gross-up. Otherwise we should treat as vendor request, not an AP default.
Maya (AP): Agreed. Meanwhile hold payment? Current payment run tomorrow. We can flag the invoice for review.
Lina (Finance): @Raj please ask vendor for the docs Omar listed and ask for an English translation of the tax notice. Also ask them to reissue invoice either with a valid VAT reg no or mark VAT as 0 with a reference to reverse-charge law.
Raj (Vendor Ops): On it. Message I'll send: "Hi - can you provide Azerbaijani VAT registration number, formal withholding certificate or treaty explanation, and reissue invoice with VAT reg no or reverse-charge reference. Also please confirm any contractual gross-up clause." Will ping when they reply.
Omar (Tax): If they can't provide VAT reg no and insist VAT is due, we should not gross-up without legal signoff. Also request vendor's bank country and whether payment will be through local payer (affects withholding).
Maya (AP): Marking invoice AZC-7789 as "payment blocked - tax docs pending" in the payment system.
FinanceBot: Invoice AZC-7789 status updated to BLOCKED by Maya (AP).
Lina (Finance): Thanks. If vendor pushes urgency we can escalate to Legal for contract review. :thumbsup: 
Raj (Vendor Ops): Reply received - they provided a PDF that looks like a tax agent registration but it's dated 2019 and no VAT number. Asking them to get formal docs, will escalate if needed.
Omar (Tax): Sounds good. I'll draft a short reply template for legal language if it escalates.
